description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of Git configurations related to the XDG base directory specification, particularly focusing on the handling of configuration files, ignore files, and attributes within the XDG directory structure. It contains test cases that verify precedence, existence, and exclusion rules for Git settings when using XDG_CONFIG_HOME and related files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output in test cases.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in output, used for verification.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables in a safe way for tests.
